# Notion

> Notion is an all-in-one AI workspace that combines docs, wikis, projects, calendar, mail, and custom agents to streamline team collaboration and enterprise workflows.

Notion offers a comprehensive platform for knowledge management, project coordination, and AI-powered automation. The platform serves teams of all sizes, from startups to Fortune 100 enterprises, with integrated tools for documentation, scheduling, email management, and intelligent workflow automation.

## Core Platform

- [The AI workspace that works for you](https://www.notion.com/product): Notion 3.0: AI workspace with custom agents, cross-app search, automation
- [Meet your AI team](https://www.notion.com/product/ai): Notion AI: search, generate, analyze, chat with custom agents and enterprise
- [Meet your 24/7 AI team](https://www.notion.com/product/custom-agents): Custom Agents: automate workflows across Slack and enterprise tools

## Workspace Tools

- [Your connected workspace for wiki, docs & projects](https://www.notion.com/product/wikis): Notion Wikis: centralized knowledge management and documentation platform
- [Docs](https://www.notion.com/product/docs): Notion Docs: next-gen collaborative notes with templates and integrations
- [Your connected workspace for wiki, docs & projects](https://www.notion.com/product/projects): Notion Projects: connected project management with agile sprint planning
- [Notion Calendar](https://www.notion.com/product/calendar): Notion Calendar: integrated time management with Google, Apple, Outlook
- [Notion Mail](https://www.notion.com/product/mail): Notion Mail: personalized inbox with AI auto-labeling and email filtering
